choices: A class with private fields and public getters/setters
A class that returns a reference to its internal mutable list from a getter
A class that validates input in its setter
A class with a package-private helper method
explanation: Returning a reference to an internal mutable list lets callers modify it directly, bypassing any validation in the class. Fix: return a defensive copy — Collections.unmodifiableList(internalList) or new ArrayList<>(internalList).
